greeting: DIG! DIG! DIG! Find the shiny!
Dan's the name, depth's the game! How deep you wanna go?
You! You look like you've got good burrowing instincts!
The earth speaks, friend! She says there's TREASURE down there!
Two years to retirement! Two years to the BIG FIND!
Deepest digger in the Dustbelt! That's me! Official record!
Come to watch? Come to dig? Come to hear about the Hollow Earth?
dialog.shop_open: Got maps! Charts! Survey data! Locations of previous cave-ins! It's all valuable!
dialog.shop_prompt: Selling dig licenses, cave maps, and my famous 'Surviving a Collapse' pamphlet!
haggle: These prices are DIRT cheap! Get it? Dirt?!
For a fellow depth enthusiast? Ten percent off!
Information is power! Power costs money!
I'll throw in a glow-stick! Free! Already half-used!
purchase_success: Wise investment! The depths reward the prepared!
That map shows the safe route! Mostly safe!
purchase_fail: Your loss! The big find is DOWN THERE!
rumor: Heard Barrelman Bob's barrels are haunted. Old digger wisdom: don't store picks in haunted wood.
The eastern shaft? Closed off. Something down there. Something that WHISPERS.
My cousin in the mines saw a barrel walk by itself. Likely heatstroke. OR WAS IT?
Metal Barrel Mike wants my survey data. Won't give it. Trade secrets!
dialog.quest_hook: Lost my lucky pick in the Old North Tunnel! Cave-in sealed it off, but I KNOW it's in there! Family heirloom! Bring it back and I'll share coordinates to the BIG vein!
dialog.quest_active: Find that pick yet? It's got 'DAN'S LUCK' carved in the handle! Can't dig without luck!
dialog.quest_complete: MY PICK! You BEAUTIFUL surface-walkers! Here - the vein coordinates! And take this helmet! Saved my life three times!
farewell: Keep your head down and your pick up!
dialog.time_dawn: Best digging light! Early morning shadows show the cracks!
dialog.time_noon: Too hot up here! Cooler in the tunnels! Let's GO!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening means evening shift! Never stop digging!
dialog.time_night: Night digging! Spookier! Better! More shadows!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The pick-finder! Hero of the depths! What can Dan do for you?
dialog.deep_earth_theory: The world is HOLLOW, friend! Full of ancient treasures! Ancient dangers! ANCIENT DIGGING OPPORTUNITIES!

party_reactions.kade: Two years to retirement. Classic last words.
party_reactions.twist: Can I dig too? I want to find something SHINY!
party_reactions.korr: Respect for the profession. The earth gives and takes.
party_reactions.renna: Does he ever... stop shouting? No? Okay.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New digger? Got your own equipment? No? Buy some!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're back! Got the digging itch, eh? I KNEW it!
relationship_dialog.friend: My favorite surface consultant! Want exclusive dig rights to Shaft 7?
relationship_dialog.best_friend: When I retire, I'm giving you my maps. ALL of them. The secrets of the deep!

mini_quest.title: Dan's Lucky Pick
mini_quest.description: Retrieve Deep-Dig Dan's family heirloom pickaxe from the collapsed North Tunnel

stages.hook: Lost my lucky pick in the Old North Tunnel! Cave-in sealed it off! Family heirloom! 'DAN'S LUCK' on the handle!
stages.active: The pick's in there! Watch for unstable sections! Three taps means RUN!
stages.complete: MY PICK! You beautiful heroes! Take these coordinates - leads to the biggest vein I've ever found! And this helmet! Three lives saved!
